completedSteps.name: Implement 24E-6 pipeline scripts
completedSteps.notes: Created three pipeline scripts in mcp_server_node/scripts/: (1) export_community_contexts.js — extracts community context from Neo4j using CommunityDetection API methods (getCommunitiesAtLevel, getCommunityMembers, getCommunityRelationships, getChildCommunities, getCommunityInteractions), processes bottom-up L0-L3, outputs data/community_contexts.json. (2) generate_llm_summaries.js — calls GitHub Models API (gpt-4o-mini) via gh auth token, 2.5s delay, resume-safe with batch checkpoints, bottom-up ordering so parent communities get child summaries, outputs data/llm_summaries.json. (3) import_llm_summaries.js — imports to both Neo4j (SET c.summary, c.summarySource='llm', c.summaryModel, c.summaryTimestamp) and ChromaDB (community-summaries collection, VectorDatabase.addDocuments auto-generates embeddings). All scripts support --dry-run and CLI arg overrides.
